good_for: AI singing voices from your melody and lyrics, voice cloning, and AI instruments that work alongside music-making software.
name: ACE Studio
price_from: $20.73/month (Artist list price, billed yearly; the page currently shows a 20% holiday discount)
watch_out: Generative kits, stem splitter, and video tools are metered from a 2,500 credits/month pool on the Artist plan.

good_for: Breeding and remixing character portraits/art with gene sliders (Splicer, Collage, Composer).
name: Artbreeder
watch_out: Monthly Starter gives 100 credits a month (the page says about 1,000 images), and unused credits reset each billing period instead of rolling over.

good_for: Running open Stable Diffusion checkpoints locally: txt2img, img2img, inpainting, LoRAs, extensions.
name: AUTOMATIC1111 Stable Diffusion WebUI
watch_out: You must install Python and git first; the guide lists support for 4GB video cards (some reports of 2GB working).

good_for: Natural-sounding text-to-speech and voice cloning from as little as 10 seconds of audio, in 30+ languages; the company also shares downloadable models you can run yourself.
name: Fish Audio
watch_out: Free Tier is for personal use only; monetizing content requires a paid plan, and unused credits do not roll over.

good_for: Simple, offline text-to-image on your own computer: type a description, fix parts of a picture, or add a style.
name: Fooocus
watch_out: Needs an Nvidia graphics card with 4GB+ of memory and 8GB of RAM (the guide says to keep 40GB of disk space free if you hit memory errors); project is in limited long-term support (bug fixes only).

good_for: Self-hosted autonomous deep-research agents that aggregate 20+ web sources into cited reports on your own machine.
name: GPT Researcher
watch_out: You must bring your own AI and search accounts (for example OpenAI and Tavily keys), and each deep research run takes about 5 minutes.

good_for: Free, expressive text-to-speech you can run yourself, with emotion tags (like laughing or sighing) and voice cloning from a short sample.
name: Orpheus TTS
watch_out: There is no app to click: you install it with Python commands and run it as code. The main models are English; other languages are only a research preview.

good_for: AI product photography: background removal/replacement, AI backgrounds, marketing assets.
name: Photoroom
watch_out: Pro includes 8,000 AI credits and 1,000 exports a month; the Video Generator and 4K output are not included in Pro.

good_for: Production phone and web voice agents with SIP telephony, no-code builder, and 20 free concurrent calls.
name: Retell AI
watch_out: Made for businesses building phone-answering bots. The real cost per minute depends on the parts you pick: Retell's voice engine is $0.055/minute, plus the AI model and the voice (Retell's own voices add $0.015/minute).

good_for: Automated transcription in 54+ languages with in-browser editing, translation, and subtitle exports.
name: Sonix
watch_out: Core includes 1 user and 5 hrs/month of transcription; extra seats are +$25/month each.

good_for: AI image upscaling on desktop (Linux, macOS, Windows); cloud plans add AI image generation.
name: Upscayl
price_from: Free to run yourself (Pro cloud from $9.99/month)
watch_out: The free desktop app needs a graphics card that supports Vulkan; many built-in (integrated) laptop graphics chips do not work.

name: ACE-Step
price_from: Free to download and run yourself
good_for: An open music model that makes full songs from a text description and lyrics on your own computer, with a simple web screen to use it.
watch_out: Setup is technical: you install it with Python, or use the ready-made download for Windows or Mac. It runs best with a strong graphics card and can be slow without one.

name: Cline
price_from: Free app (you pay for the AI as you use it, or ClinePass $9.99/month)
good_for: An AI helper that plans, writes and changes code for you, inside the VS Code code editor, in a command window, or in a new desktop app (still in testing)
watch_out: The app is free, but the AI it uses is not: you buy AI credits as you go, connect your own paid account from a company like OpenAI or Anthropic, or subscribe to ClinePass ($9.99/month). Made for people who write code

name: Ecrett Music
good_for: Making simple background music for videos, games and podcasts: pick a scene, mood and style, and its AI makes a new tune you can use without paying extra each time
watch_out: The free plan only downloads preview music, which you may not publish or use to make money. To use tracks in your videos you need Individual ($7.99/month). The music is meant to go inside videos, games or podcasts, not to be sold or shared as songs on their own

name: Fadr
good_for: Using AI to pull a song apart into separate tracks (vocals, drums, bass, melody) and remix it, even with no music experience
watch_out: The free plan splits songs into the main parts and gives MP3 downloads only. Finer splits (like single drums), higher-quality WAV files and the add-ons for music software need Fadr Plus

name: Fliki
good_for: Turns a script, blog post or slides into a video with a realistic AI voice, stock footage and music.
watch_out: The free plan makes 720p videos with a Fliki watermark and gives only 3 credits a month. Standard gives 180 credits a month.

name: Hedra
good_for: Makes AI video, images and talking avatars from a prompt, in a web studio with an AI assistant.
watch_out: There is no free plan in the price table, and making videos uses paid credits. Basic gives 2,000 credits a month with slower generations; faster generation starts at $50/month on the Pro plan.

name: JetBrains AI
price_from: Free (3 AI Credits per 30 days); AI Pro $10/month
good_for: AI chat, code suggestions and a coding helper built into JetBrains code editors such as IntelliJ IDEA and PyCharm.
watch_out: You need a JetBrains code editor installed, and the free plan only works in the paid (commercial) editors: not in IntelliJ IDEA or PyCharm without a paid subscription, and not in Android Studio. The free plan has only 3 AI Credits per 30 days, and AI Pro has 10.

name: Kilo Code
price_from: Free (AI model usage is billed separately; Teams plan $15/user/month)
good_for: An AI coding helper you add to VS Code or JetBrains, or run in the terminal. It can use free models, models on your own computer, or your own keys from other AI companies.
watch_out: The tool itself is free, but the AI models it talks to cost money unless you pick the free or local ones.

name: Kiro
good_for: A downloadable AI coding editor and command-line tool from Amazon that works as a coding agent on your projects.
watch_out: The free plan gives 50 credits and only some AI models, with rate limits. On the paid plans, extra credits cost $0.04 each.
